about: DFW Injury Lawyers holds six verified offices, three in Dallas and one each in Fort Worth, Arlington and Lancaster, which is the widest local footprint in this ranking, and names its two founders, Pedro de la Cerda and Kevin Edwards.

A free consultation and a 24 hour line, published in English and Spanish. 1,437 reviews at 4.93, the highest average of any firm here above a thousand reviews. It states no fee model in terms we could record.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 6 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed. The franchise tax does not reach a sole proprietorship or a general partnership, so this register can confirm an entity and cannot rule one out.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 1,437 public client reviews across 6 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2012-03-25, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
